About this space
This spacious 3-bedroom house offers a comfortable and convenient living experience. It features 3 cozy bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and an open living space with a TV & WiFi perfect for entertainment. The kitchen is fully equipped with both electric and gas & an ac. Additionally, the washer and dryer make this house an ideal choice for a relaxing and hassle-free stay. Please note solar backup is for Fridge, lights, TV and WiFi only. Air conditioner & booster pump not available on Solar.Outdoor Camera
